text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sitting in the cafeteria and thinking
hard
about tomorrow's training, when...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uerghhh! This homework is so hard!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Enough to make you cry?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Ticket. Use reason to solve
it, not
emotion.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, that makes sense. Let's all
figure this out
together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm leaving. I already did mine.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WHAT?! Already?! Am I that far
behind?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What are you having trouble with? Let's
look at
that problem first.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! My head feels as mushy as turf
on a
rainy day!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What am I having trouble with? I don't even know anymore!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...There's no hope for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... As long as you snap out of your
confusion
and focus, it's really not that
hard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The only time she isn't confused is when
she's
running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's it! You're right, Taishin.
Quick,
Ticket. Start running!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What? Run? Yay! ...Are you sure,
though?
Shouldn't I be studying?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Go on. Take a lap at full speed and clear
your
head.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whatever works.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while later...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm baaaaack!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there's a sparkle in her eye all of a
sudden.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm, looks like she's back to normal.
Now, sit
down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Start with the practice problem. Read it
clearly
and think hard before you
answer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this loudmouth is quietly
reading
for once...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Yes, that's correct. Seems like
running
really does help you
concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But for each question? There's no way
that'll work
during a test.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We can worry about that later. This is
good for
now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. You're always too nice to Ticket, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're one to talk. For all your
complaining, I
notice you're still sticking
around for moral
support.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?! It's not like I...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks, you two! I finally found a
way to
focus!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Now help me get through the rest
too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Less talking, more studying. C'mon,
open your
book.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The way you go full throttle always
inspires us.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And yet you too seem to derive so much
of your
energy from our support.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You truly are an enigma, Ticket.
